name: DeepBrain AI

summary.text: DeepBrain AI is a South Korean 'virtual human' company whose Re;memory service, announced in 2022 and shown at CES 2023, creates a video avatar of a person from studio filming and interviews so that relatives can converse with it after death, including in a memorial showroom; press reports put the cost at roughly $12,000–$24,000 per avatar. In June 2024 the company launched re;memory2, which it says needs a single photo and a 10-second audio clip.

sources.title: DeepBrain AI to bring back deceased loved ones – virtually
DeepBrain AI Launches 're;memory2' Based on Dream Avatar Solution for Hyper-Personalized Virtual Humans

facts.claim: The Korea Economic Daily reported in June 2022 that DeepBrain AI planned a service to bring back deceased loved ones virtually.

sources.title: DeepBrain AI to bring back deceased loved ones – virtually

facts.claim: The original Re;memory required the subject to visit a studio for about three hours of filming and interviews; press reports citing the Daily Mail estimated $12,000–$24,000 to create a virtual person plus about $1,200 per conversation in a private memorial showroom.
facts.quote: The model had to visit a studio for about three hours of filming and interviews.

sources.title: Eerie AI Tech Processes Photos to Let You Talk to Dead Loved Ones

facts.claim: DeepBrain AI announced re;memory2 in June 2024, stating that the new service needs just a single photo and a 10-second audio clip to create an avatar playable on any video-capable device.

sources.title: DeepBrain AI Launches 're;memory2' Based on Dream Avatar Solution for Hyper-Personalized Virtual Humans

facts.claim: DeepBrain AI has announced a partnership with a funeral provider to build virtual beings for 'AI memorial services'.

sources.title: Deepbrain AI Teams With Funeral Provider to Build Virtual Beings for 'AI Memorial Services'

connections.claim: DeepBrain AI's Re;memory is a commercial 're-creation' service of the kind the academic literature classifies within the digital afterlife industry.
